"MAX-A-MILLION" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $1 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "MAX-A-MILLION" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
985.headline: Close to two months, no top prize claimed

988.body:
The most common win left on "Emerald 10's" is $10. The second biggest prize left is $50,000, and three of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "Emerald 10's" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
988.headline: The prize table, line by line

990.body:
"LADY LUCK" has two of four top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "LADY LUCK" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

993.headline: Top prizes are still left

994.body:
"$25,000 Triple Play" has one of four top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

If you play "$25,000 Triple Play" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

996.body:
"$1,000,000 Triple Play" has had no $1 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

If you play "$1,000,000 Triple Play" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
